summary: The base already initialized MoE runtime flags for bench_one_batch latency runs, but correctness runs still reached shared model loading with the lazy AUTO backend even when ServerArgs requested AITER. MoE initialization now occurs in load_model before ModelConfig and ModelRunner construction, covering both entry paths without changing backend resolution semantics.
